title: Evaluating $\mathrm {SU}(3)$ Verlinde sums using spectral graph theory
summary: We realize the $\mathrm{SU}(3)$ Verlinde sums $V_n(m)$, up to an explicit factor, as the values at $n$ of the spectral zeta function of a higher-order Laplace operator on the triangular discrete torus on $m^2$ vertices. For fixed $m$, we express their generating function in terms of the logarithmic derivative of an associated even spectral polynomial and express this polynomial as an explicit iterated resultant.
